works.title: The Color Between Worlds
works.story: Color folds into color in a mirrored world of electric yellow, green, violet, and fire. Shapes emerge, divide, and return to the center, creating a vision that seems to change with every glance. What first appears as chaos becomes a dance of reflection, symmetry, and possibility.
works.alt: Digital artwork of mirrored electric yellow, green, violet, and fire shapes.
